name: Thien Hau Temple
kicker: The sea goddess hall in Chợ Lớn
summary: Sea-goddess temple in Chợ Lớn: enter the 1760 hall for the ceramic roof and the red lanterns. The Cantonese community from Tuệ Thành county built Hội quán Tuệ Thành. Roof ceramics from the Bửu Nguyên and Đồng Hòa kilns date to Mậu Thân 1908. A Sunday morning can end here after Tao Đàn.
getThere: On the Chợ Lớn walk. A Sunday morning can end here after Tao Đàn and Chợ Tân Định.
heroCaption: The street front, the ceramic roof, and the red lanterns

notice.title: A different hall from Ngọc Hoàng
notice.body: Ngọc Hoàng is on Mai Thị Lựu. Giác Lâm is in Phường Bảy Hiền. Chùa Quan Âm, Hội quán Ôn Lăng, is a second hall in Chợ Lớn.

body: The building is also Hội quán Tuệ Thành, the hall of Thiên Hậu Thánh Mẫu, the goddess of the sea. The incense set inside is the largest of the city’s temples. The district labels are District 5 and Chợ Lớn. The lunar feast days sit with the other events.
The photograph is the street front: the ceramic roof, the gate, and the lanterns. The second photograph is the courtyard gate. A Sunday morning starts at Tao Đàn, passes Chợ Tân Định, and ends here.

figures.caption: The courtyard gate, the ceramic roof, and lanterns
figures.alt: Courtyard gate of Thien Hau Pagoda in Cho Lon

gettingThere: Ride from the cathedral square with the rest of Chợ Lớn.

legs.heading: From Tao Đàn on a Sunday
legs.body: A Sunday morning can start in Tao Đàn, then Chợ Tân Định, and end here.

hours: Check on arrival. The lunar feast days are a separate visit.
